name: Gmail
description: Connect Gmail through Google's hosted MCP or through the direct Gmail API, with separate read-only and full mailbox access profiles.

setupPrerequisite.title: Required only for Google-hosted Gmail MCP methods
setupPrerequisite.description: The Paperclip-managed and hosted Gmail MCP methods require Google Developer Preview registration for both the Workspace email and Cloud project. The direct Gmail API method uses the Gmail REST API and does not require Developer Preview enrollment.
steps: Apply with the Workspace email that will sign in and the Google Cloud project that owns the OAuth client.
Wait for the Google Group notification and then Google's final project-registration email, usually within a couple of days.
Add every additional tester email or Cloud project through Google's member request forms before connecting.
setupPrerequisite.actionLabel: Apply or verify Developer Preview enrollment

methods.label: Connect Gmail directly (read access)

capabilityProfile.label: Read only
capabilityProfile.description: Search and read Gmail messages and labels through the Gmail API.

methods.whenToUse: Use your Google OAuth client to connect a personal Gmail account directly through Paperclip's Gmail API read-only connector.
methods.guidanceMd: Create a Google OAuth web client, add Paperclip's callback URI, enable the Gmail API, then authorize the Gmail account. This connector calls the Gmail REST API directly and does not require Gmail MCP Developer Preview enrollment.
warnings: This connection is read only. Google may show an unverified app warning unless the OAuth app is verified.

methods.label: Connect with Paperclip

capabilityProfile.label: Read only
capabilityProfile.description: Search and read messages, threads, drafts, and labels.

methods.whenToUse: Use Paperclip-managed Google OAuth for read-only Gmail access.
methods.guidanceMd: Connect Gmail with read-only access. Sending, deleting, moving, and relabeling mail are not enabled.
warnings: Google Workspace MCP servers are in Developer Preview.

methods.label: Use your own Google OAuth app

capabilityProfile.label: Read only
capabilityProfile.description: Search and read messages, threads, drafts, and labels.

methods.whenToUse: Use a customer-owned Google OAuth client for read-only Gmail access.
methods.guidanceMd: Enable the Gmail and Gmail MCP APIs in your Google Cloud project, then register Paperclip's callback URI.
warnings: Google Workspace MCP servers are in Developer Preview.

methods.label: Connect with Paperclip

capabilityProfile.label: Read & create drafts
capabilityProfile.description: Read Gmail and create drafts for review in Gmail.

methods.whenToUse: Use Paperclip-managed Google OAuth to read Gmail and create drafts.
methods.guidanceMd: Connect Gmail to search and read mail and create drafts. Sending is unavailable on this shared profile.
warnings: Draft creation requires approval. Sending is unavailable on this profile.
Google Workspace MCP servers are in Developer Preview.

methods.guidanceMd: Enable the Gmail and Gmail MCP APIs in your Google Cloud project, then register Paperclip's callback URI.
warnings: Draft creation requires approval. Sending is unavailable on this profile.
Google Workspace MCP servers are in Developer Preview.

methods.label: Connect with Paperclip

capabilityProfile.label: Read & archive
capabilityProfile.description: Read Gmail and archive threads by removing only the Inbox label.

methods.whenToUse: Use Paperclip-managed Google OAuth to read Gmail and archive threads.
methods.guidanceMd: Connect Gmail to search and read mail and archive threads. Archive removes only the Inbox label; sending, trashing, and other label changes remain disabled.
warnings: Archiving requires approval and only removes the Inbox label.
Google Workspace MCP servers are in Developer Preview.
